description: This file contains a series of shell commands that implement tests for Git's reflog display functionalities. It sets up test repositories, runs various git log and reflog commands with different options, and verifies their outputs against expected results.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: A function to define a test case expecting success, runs the given commands and verifies the output.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: A function that introduces a timestamp tick to ensure unique commit times.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: A function to compare expected and actual output files.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that the output of a command is empty.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
